questions.question: Which organisation is responsible for estimating poverty in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (National Sample Survey Office) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true with respect to the process of photosynthesis in plants?
options: It involves the breakdown of glucose to produce energy.
It converts light energy into chemical energy.
It primarily takes place during the night to conserve water.
It occurs in the mitochondria of plant cells.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (It converts light energy into chemical energy.) है।
